title: Motion kinetic type
caption: The motion-kinetic-type recipe: the line builds word by word while one liquid highlight springs from word to word and shows each word inverted through a mask.
prompt: Use the magnifito-promo skill to make a 5 second 16:9 clip for Magnifito, a Bulgarian digital marketing agency, in the motion-kinetic-type style only: the line "Great businesses deserve to be seen online" builds word by word with the liquid highlight. Use the motion engine. Brand colours are warm browns on cream (#7a584c, #ae8c72, #f0eadf), Geist for type, English on screen.
